name: fix99_unique_chest
verifies: fix-99 #3: an ornate unique-weapon chest (G3_Object_Interact_Animated_Chest_Unique_Weapon, TS_Unique_Weapons: 48 weapons, min = max = 1) gives ONE weapon as G3 gCTreasureSet_PS::GeneratePlunderInventory does — the cheapest not handed out yet (It_1H_AssDagger_01, 350 gold), not all 48; the roll and the ledger survive a save/load (reopening gives nothing), and the next unique chest gives the next one (It_Bow_Ass, 400)
notes: Before fix-99 InteractiveObjects.Fill rolled a Unique set with GenerateAll: the owner got all 48 weapons, bows, crossbows and recipes from the Reddock cave chest (674.49, 39.82, -71.09), id ad2f73ed-9a6a-458c-8870-0c52d1fb34c1. Second chest: 0b0565f1-eac4-4950-8ce9-8d43048b7c38 at (857.35, 48.07, -3.12). fix-105 (r40: the second chest gave +0 items): it stands in an outlaw camp, OutNovice_08 and OutWarrior_04 attack the hero at once and G3 refuses looting during a fight (NotDuringBattle), so the camp is calmed first. The plunder set TS_Treasure_Big adds 5-7 random stacks to each (none of them a unique weapon). Ledger: save section rules.treasure.
